# moomem

> Embedded agent-memory library for MoonBit (`heyq02/moomem`). It lives inside the host process: `open` / `add` / `recall` / `forget`, hybrid vector + BM25 search sharded by `user_id`, and a native dual-slot JSONL snapshot. Defaults are offline and deterministic.

The host surface is `MemoryStore` only: `open`, `add`, `recall`, `forget`, `stats`, `close`, plus `list_entries`, `export_jsonl`, and `import_jsonl`. Indexes, dedup, `rrf`, and tokenizers are not a second public API. Fallible paths return `Result[T, MoomemError]`; library code does not panic.

On native, `open(path)` writes `<path>/moomem/head` plus `slot0.jsonl` and `slot1.jsonl`. The snapshot is the only source of truth (full rewrite, not an append-only log). wasm and js default to an in-memory backend and do not persist unless the host injects `PersistenceBackend`. Hosts inject `Embedder`, `Extractor`, and `ConflictJudge` when they want real models; `None` stays offline (`HashingEmbedder`, `RawExtractor`, `SimilarityJudge`). The core package must not import an LLM SDK.

Toolchain is `moon` (documented baseline ≥ `0.1.20260920`), not Node. Package version is `moon.mod` (currently `0.7.1`); `src/lib.mbt` `MOOMEM_VERSION` must match. Snapshot header `v` is `SNAPSHOT_VERSION` (`1`) and is independent of the package version. `demo/` is a separate module (`heyq02/demo`) that depends on the published package, not this working tree. Published docs: [heyq02/moomem on mooncakes](https://mooncakes.io/docs/heyq02/moomem/).

## Examples

- [Examples overview](examples/README.md): Three offline native demos and what each one shows
- [Default reopen](examples/default-reopen/main.mbt): Write, recall, close, and open the same directory
- [Host inject and supersede](examples/host-inject-supersede/main.mbt): Injected embedder and extractor; an old fact is superseded
- [Isolation, forget, import](examples/isolation-forget-import/main.mbt): Per-user isolation, soft delete, export, and import
- [Offline benchmark](benchmark/README.md): LoCoMo-style retrieval, near-duplicate, isolation, and restart checks
- [Live host demo](demo/cmd/main/main.mbt): Qwen embed and DeepSeek extract; needs local secrets, not used by CI
